COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.3742 of 2025
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Mehboob Rahi, learned counsel 
for petitioner-defendant.
2. By means of present writ petition, 
petitioner-defendant prayed for following 
reliefs:-
I. Set aside the impugned order dated 17.12.2024 
(Annexure No.10) whereby petitioner’s application 
under Order 26 Rule 9 of C.P.C. under Section 151 of 
C.P.C. has been dismissed.
II. Set aside the order dated 17.12.2024 (Annexure 
No.13) whereby respondent’s application filed under 
Order 6 Rule 17 under Section 151 of C.P.C. has been 
allowed.
III. Set aside the order dated 21.11.2025 passed by the 
Learned Revisional Court whereby the applications filed 
by the respondent seeking amendment in plaint being 
application numbers 100A1 and 71A1 have been 
allowed and the application seeking commission paper 
no.16C2 has been rejected (Annexure No.19).
3. This Court having heard learned 
counsel for petitioner-defendant is only 
inclined to issue notice to respondent￾plaintiff only on the point as to why 
application moved by petitioner￾defendant for commission under Order 26 
Rule 9 of CPC, which was rejected by 
learned Trial Court and affirmed the 
rejection of application by learned 
Revisional Court, be not allowed.
4. Issue notice to respondent-plaintiff, 
returnable within six weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within 07 days.
6. Put up on 09.03.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 02.01.2026 PN
